Direct symbolic det(λI−J) gives q_a(λ)=λ^4+λ^3+(3−a/10)λ²+(a+21/10)λ−a/10 exactly. Independent SymPy discriminant agrees identically with P(a)/50000; Δ2=(9−11a)/10>0 and Δ3=−(110a²+131a−189)/100. Thus Routh first column (1,1,Δ2,Δ3/Δ2,−a/10) yields unstable dimension 2 below a_H and 0 above. At a_H, q factors into (λ²+ω²)(λ²+λ+c) with ω²=A3>0, c>0, proving a simple imaginary pair and stable complement. Independent exact rational polynomial root-isolation and Sturm/count_roots computed exactly two simple discriminant zeros inside [-10,-1], alpha∈(-4.871964812,-4.871964811), beta∈(-1.009024345,-1.009024344); root counts of q at -10,-4,-2,-1 respectively (positive,negative)=(2,0),(0,0),(0,0),(0,2). These and no further collisions establish all four regimes; double coalescence sign follows continuous eigenvalues and simple discriminant crossing. Endpoints -10 and -1 included; alpha/a_H/beta boundaries separately described. The polynomial and assumptions concern local linear spectra only, no nonlinear periodic or chaotic claims.
